% Floats of unknown height, as a thesis class places them: etoolbox
% patches \@xfloat, wide floats, five floats in one paragraph, and a
% \clearpage. Each float takes a box from \@freelist and the output
% routine gives it back: no float is lost, every \@currbox is a box.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{etoolbox}
\makeatletter
\apptocmd\@xfloat{\relax}{}{}
\makeatother
\newcommand\fig[1]{\begin{figure}[#1]\centering
  \rule{1cm}{\pdfuniformdeviate 300pt}\caption{A float}\end{figure}}
\newcommand\wfig[1]{\begin{figure*}[#1]\centering
  \rule{1cm}{\pdfuniformdeviate 300pt}\caption{A wide float}\end{figure*}}
\begin{document}
Text one.
\wfig{h!}
Text two.
\fig{htbp}
\fig{h!}
Text three.
\fig{htbp}
\wfig{tbp}
Text four.

\fig{htbp}

More text.
\clearpage
After the page.

\fig{htbp}
\fig{h!}
\gdef\SatexReachedEnd{}
\end{document}
